{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion fusers''' were used to soften and potentially liquefy metals. Ion fusers were used in the manufacture of [[molecularly bonded armor]] to soften metals held in [[texture-molding tractor field]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
